title: Let promote reach retired cells and read its areas from the scribing ledger
action: Give bee knowledge promote two reaches it lacks. FIRST: it mines only .bee/cells/<id>.json today, so every feature whose cells already retired proposes nothing — measured, promote --work okf-foundation returns 0 cells, 0 area bullets, 0 pattern candidates even though that feature has a work item and shipped. Make it mine .bee/cells/archive/<feature>/*.json alongside .bee/cells/*.json, dedup by cell id with the live copy winning, and keep each cell's recorded trace_path pointing at wherever the trace actually is. SECOND: when the resolved work item declares no bee.areas — which is every feature reached through the history anchor — read the area list from the feature's most recent entry in the append-only ledger .bee/logs/scribing-runs.jsonl, whose entries carry {ts, feature, areas}. read_scribing_ledger in verbs/state_group/ledger.rs already reads that file; reuse it rather than re-parsing. The output must NAME where the areas came from: a work item's bee.areas, or the scribing stamp and its timestamp. When neither yields an area, keep the existing render at promote.rs:714-720 unchanged. The area subject matching itself does not change: subjects still come from each area's concept paths and bee.sources, matched by touches_subject. writes stays an empty array in every case — promote proposes and never writes (D38, docs/knowledge/areas/okf-profile/context-and-promote.md:147).

truths: bee knowledge promote --work okf-foundation mines its retired cells instead of returning zero
A cell that exists both live and archived is mined once, with the live copy winning
A feature whose work item declares no bee.areas takes its area list from its most recent scribing-run ledger entry
The output names whether the areas came from the work item or from the scribing stamp
A feature with neither a bee.areas list nor a scribing-run entry keeps today's unchanged no-areas render

artifacts.substantive: archive-aware cell mining and scribing-ledger area derivation; no TODO stubs

key_links: promote.rs reads the scribing ledger through verbs/state_group/ledger.rs
prohibitions: writes stays an empty array in every promote payload
No file under docs/knowledge/ is created, moved, or deleted
The unknown_work message text and exit code do not change
touches_subject and the area subject-collection logic keep their current behaviour

trace.outcome: knowledge promote mines .bee/cells/archive/<feature>/*.json (dedup, live wins) and falls back to the scribing ledger for areas when the work item declares none, naming the source in both JSON and text
